subject: AP onboarding: remit details, PO routing fields, and invoice visibility
body:
From: Helen Park <helen.park@aurora-trading.de>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +02:00
Subject: Vendor registration & PO formatting questions for Redwood

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist you shared during the demo. We need to register Redwood as a supplier in our SAP landscape so our AP team can route POs and pay on time. Before we start, two quick questions so we can prepare the right evidence:

1) Which PO fields do you require to guarantee automated matching? (we need exact field names so our PO payload aligns)
2) For EU payments, do you accept an IBAN + redacted bank statement, or do you require a full bank letter?

I've attached our internal vendor request form to speed this up. If you can confirm the PO field mapping and a short list of accepted bank evidence, we'll kick vendor creation on our side and schedule a test invoice.

Thanks,
Helen Park
AP Manager | Aurora Trading GmbH
accounts-payable@aurora-trading.de
[Attachment: Aurora_vendor_enroll_form.pdf (PDF)]

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@aurora-trading.de>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 13:04:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO formatting questions for Redwood

Hi Helen — great to hear from you. We can get this over the line quickly. Answers below plus next steps.

PO field mapping (minimum to ensure automated matching):
- PO Number: po_number (string) — must be present on invoice header
- Line Item ID: line_item_id (string) — included per-line on itemized invoices
- Net Amount: net_amount (decimal)
- Tax/VAT Amount: tax_amount (decimal)
- GL/Cost Center: cost_center (string) — optional but helpful for your internal routing
- Invoice Date / Due Date: invoice_date / due_date (ISO 8601)

Please ensure PO Number is in the invoice header PDF text layer (not only in an image). Our AP process requires an exact match to po_number for automatic PO-linking.

Accepted bank evidence for EU entities:
- Preferred: bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account name + IBAN (scanned PDF).
- Acceptable alternative: recent bank statement with account name and IBAN, redacted transactions are fine.
We can accept the redacted bank statement you mentioned.

Next steps:
1) Please complete and return your vendor_enroll_form (attached) with VAT ID and IBAN.
2) Upload VAT certificate and redacted remit proof to the Drive folder we shared (link below) or attach to your reply.
3) When we receive the documents we'll create the vendor record and send a test PO (non-financial test) for you to map fields.

Drive folder for documents: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEfGK-enrollment
HubSpot ref: HS-47291

I've CC'd Vanessa (sales ops) who will coordinate the vendor record creation and Connor (finance) to confirm the matching rules on our side.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_instructions.pdf (PDF)]

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:18:00 +02:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor registration & PO formatting questions for Redwood

Vanessa / Connor — forwarding Aurora's form (attached above). Short internal asks:
- Vanessa: can you spin up the vendor profile after Helen returns VAT/IBAN? Make sure vendor is flagged for EU VAT reverse-charge if their VAT ID validates as non-German EU? Aurora is German, so normal VAT applies, but confirm tax handling.
- Connor: confirm the PO field names below match our matching engine. We should add a fallback that accepts PO-number in the PDF body as a last-resort parse if po_number metadata is missing. Any objections?

I'll chase Helen for the VAT cert and bank proof.

Thanks,
Marissa

-----
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 10:22:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor registration & PO formatting questions for Redwood

Quick update from ops:
- I'll create the vendor shell in our onboarding tracker once we receive the completed form.
- Required fields we'll capture in the shell: legal_name, tax_id (VAT), remit_address, ibAN, currency, primary_contact_email, payment_terms.
- For PO routing we'll map their PO sources (SAP XML v2) to our internal route (route_id: eu_standard). If Helen confirms the PO payload uses the field "po_number" we can enable 100% auto-linking; otherwise we'll schedule a test.
- Attachments to request from the customer: VAT certificate (pdf), redacted bank statement or bank letter (pdf), signed W-9 not applicable (EU), and a sample PO in the XML format if possible.

Connor: we'll need the fallback parsing behavior documented in the vendor record so CS doesn't get paged on every invoice exception. Also suggest a 48-hour SLA for test PO verification before marking the vendor as live.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
[Attachment: onboarding_field_map.xlsx (XLSX)]

-----
From: Helen Park <helen.park@aurora-trading.de>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@aurora-trading.de
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 14:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO formatting questions for Redwood

Hi Marissa — attached the completed form plus the VAT cert and a redacted bank statement. We also exported a sample SAP PO XML and included a short mapping file showing how our fields label the PO number and line items.

Files attached: VAT_certificate_Aurora.pdf, IBAN_remit_proof_redacted.pdf, Aurora_vendor_enroll_form.pdf, sample_po_export.xml

We can schedule the test PO exchange for Friday 14 Aug at 09:00 CEST if that works for your ops team. Please confirm and share the test PO endpoint or preferred upload method.

Best,
Helen Park
AP Manager | Aurora Trading GmbH
accounts-payable@aurora-trading.de
